long_description: All-in-one destiny charting for AI agents: cast BaZi (Four Pillars, 八字/四柱推命/사주), Zi Wei Dou Shu (紫微斗數), and Western astrology natal charts with a single tool. Deterministic engines with True Solar Time correction, multilingual birth input (中文/EN/日本語/한국어), free and anonymous — no account or API key required. Official MCP server by FateNava (fatenava.com).
